image_prompt.text: Frozen tundra landform shaping the whole island: icy cliffs and snow-covered rises with gray rock breaking through underneath, jagged ice formations across the flats, and a frozen cave mouth cut into one cliff face
A frozen lake set into the tundra, a flat sheet of pale blue ice read as solid ground rather than open water
Ice crystal spires rising well above the island, tall enough to steer by from anywhere on the shoreline
Pine trees under heavy snow scattered across the island, thinning out toward the higher ice
A cold palette throughout: white snow, pale blue ice, gray rock beneath

notes: would have asked: Sounds like a single continuous high-level island built as frozen tundra: icy cliffs and snow ridges over gray rock, a frozen lake, snow-laden pines, and ice crystal spires standing over it all as the thing you steer by. Closest preset was Exploration, but that bundle's walking trail and hidden discovery alcoves are not in the prompt, and its shape is not the dominant genre's, so only the landmark survived and the preset is emitted as null rather than being carried through unrecognisable.

would have asked: 'Cold and challenging' — is the challenge environmental (crevasses, thin ice, blizzard ground that punishes careless traversal) or is it high-level mobs on the island? Neither hazard option was added, because the prompt states a difficulty tier and a mood rather than either feature.

would have asked: This is described as a high-level island — should the level gating be physical, a guarded pass or ice crack at the landing, or purely by location as in the reference game? No gate-progression was added without an answer.
would have asked: Anything else you want in the space?

Cave: the prompt asks for a frozen cave entrance, so it is built as a mouth in the cliff face with no interior volume, which keeps terrain-relief at P0 + tiered. A walk-in ice cave would push it to P2, which is not ready yet — deferred, say the word and it can be picked up when it is.
CHECK on water-body should clear immediately: the lake is frozen solid and walked across rather than swum, so there is no volumetric play space and nothing self-occludes.

Exposed attributes requested by the prompt and not expressible in this block: islandSize (overall scale), snowCoverage (snow on terrain), iceSpireHeight (height of the ice crystal formations), treeCount (number of snow-covered trees). No values were given, so no counts are recorded; these need surfacing as tunable attributes downstream.

Classification: the 'Blox Fruits-style' reference is the genre signal — a levelling combat RPG whose world is an explorable archipelago — so RPG leads and Adventure is named second, with RPG owning the shape. The prompt itself describes only environment, no town, shops, quests, NPCs or mob nests, so no RPG or Adventure gameplay options were added on top of what it asked for.
Scope is the one island; island-cluster was not taken, since only a single landmass was requested even though the reference world is an archipelago.
